Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the MAP draft. A few clarifications from our side:

- PHI scope: yes — we will be sending full PHI for certain workflows (patient identifiers, limited clinical notes). We need to ensure any PHI in logs is redacted by default and that payload retention is configurable.
- Retention: Our security policy requires logs containing identifiers to be retained for 365 days, payloads with PHI should be purgeable to a configurable window (30/90/365).
- Logging & audit trails: we need an exportable audit trail for any data access with timestamps and user/service identities.

Could you also share your SOC2 report (summary is fine) and a sample audit log schema? I've attached our internal security questionnaire for reference.

If possible, let's put the target MAP milestone at 2026-03-15 but contingent on legal and SOC2 review.

Thanks — Alicia

Alicia Gomez
Director of Product | MedTech Co.
agomez@medtechco.com
